decisions.title: Dual-Track FHIR Datastore Architecture

selected_options.track_b_gcp: Google Cloud Healthcare API (FHIR R4 dataset & store)

immutable_invariants: Primary clinical data store must conform strictly to HL7 FHIR R4 schema.
No proprietary or non-FHIR document databases permitted as primary clinical datastores.
No ad-hoc swapping of datastore engine within sprint PRs.

decisions.title: Edge Gateway Security & Public Doorway Isolation

selected_options.network_topology: Bridge VPC for edge ingress; private Data VPC with zero internet egress

immutable_invariants: All incoming requests terminate at edge gateway; zero direct internet access to backend stores.
Pipeline service credentials must remain cryptographically segregated from member bearer tokens.
Public access blocked on all cloud buckets (BlockPublicAccess=true).

decisions.title: Electronic Prior Authorization (ePA) Profile A Selection

selected_options.selected_profile: Profile A (Flat-File Ingestion to FHIR PAS)

immutable_invariants: Prior authorization pipeline must ingest CSV/JSON flat batches into FHIR PAS Claim and ClaimResponse resources.
Daily batch reconciliation pattern enforced.
No sprint may unilaterally migrate endpoints to Option B without change request approval.

decisions.title: Claims-Driven Attribution & Single Line of Business Scope

selected_options.fhir_resource: PDexProviderGroup at Organization + Location + Provider level

immutable_invariants: Active treatment relationship must be established prior to bulk provider export.
Member opt-out consent must be honored before any data transmission.
Secondary commercial lines of business excluded from baseline scope.

decisions.title: Synthetic Data Isolation & Hard Production Gate Policy

selected_options.production_gate: Hard-gated (Zero PHI / Zero real member records)

immutable_invariants: Development and staging pipelines exclusively process synthetic batch SYN-ELP-EPA-01.
Production environment remains strictly empty (abacus:production-tenant = none).
No live PHI/PII permitted until formal HIPAA audit and security gate sign-off.

decisions.title: Two-Speed Ingestion Cadence & Idempotent Schema Quarantine

selected_options.weekly_cadence: Weekly Master Batch (Demographics, Coverage, Historical Encounters)
selected_options.nightly_cadence: Nightly Reconciliation Prefix (ClaimResponse & Pre-auth EOB mapping)

immutable_invariants: Declared schema enforcement on all bronze landings; missing columns or unmapped fields quarantined.
Reconciliation equality checks must pass: landing row count == bronze count == silver count.
Streaming gold pipelines disallowed without certified bronze batch integrity.

decisions.title: CDS Hooks Conformance & Sub-5-Second CRD Latency SLA

selected_options.fail_safe_rule: Unlisted clinical codes default to 'Prior Authorization Required'

immutable_invariants: All six mandatory CDS Hooks supported.
Hook evaluations executed against fast-path relational cache; no heavy lakehouse scans in path.
Fail-safe rule must prevent false negatives on prior authorization requirement.

decisions.title: Privacy Invariants & Count-Only Audit Trail Standard
immutable_invariants: Zero member identifiers, SSNs, claim values, or clinical payloads logged.
Zero payload tokens in AI assistant prompts or ticket descriptions.
Audit logs immutable and retained in encrypted dedicated storage buckets.
